newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures mostly down on supply concern.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures mostly down on supply concern.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly lower on Tuesday, pressured by expectations of ample supply in the short term and the yen's rise against the dollar, traders said.
Newly listed benchmark August closed at 150.0 yen after opening at 149.9 yen. Other prices ranged from 0.5 yen per kg lower to 1.3 yen firmer.

The market started the day on a weaker tone, with bearish sentiment carried over from the previous day. "Given bearish sentiment, the benchmark August is likely to test support at 148 yen in the near future," one trader said.
